title: plastic sandwich cutters and sealer
text: plastic sandwich cutters and sealer. Ok... sort of works, but only crimps one side.  I've tried flipping and sealing the other side but it doesn't really work.  Also, you need to be sure you don't spread peanut butter or other sandwich makings all they way to the edge of the bread or you won't get any seal.  It works but it's a process and if you're kids are as critical as mine they will point out the differences. I did wash them in top rack of the dishwasher - no problems.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
